apps.localizedDescription: Run x86-64 Windows PC games on iPhone and iPad - no jailbreak. Madeira bundles FEX-Emu, Wine, and DXMT, and puts your GOG, Epic Games, EA app, and itch.io libraries in one place: sign in, download, and play. Requires iOS 18 or later. The IPA links straight to the official willfaust/Madeira GitHub release, and this repo tracks new releases automatically.
apps.name: Madeira
apps.subtitle: Windows PC games on iOS

versions.localizedDescription: Adds a GOG section (sign in, library, downloads, Galaxy achievements and stats), an EA app section (library and downloads), and itch.io support. Epic Games downloads and cloud saves now work together. New store tabs when more than one store is enabled.

apps.localizedDescription: Stremio's official app: movies, series, live TV and add-ons in one place. These are Stremio's own builds, mirrored from their CDN (dl.strem.io) to GitHub so this repo can track them - the 2.1.1 (build 25) files were verified byte-identical to Stremio's official copies.
apps.name: Stremio
apps.subtitle: Freedom to stream

apps.localizedDescription: Playport runs Windows games - 64-bit and 32-bit - on a stock, non-jailbroken iPhone: install a game from your library, pick up a controller, and play. The game runs on the phone's own CPU and GPU - no PC, no cloud, no streaming. The IPA links straight to the official playportdev/playport GitHub release, and this repo tracks new releases automatically.
apps.name: Playport
apps.subtitle: Windows games on iOS
